intent.summary: New OrgX-skill-guided verification of Hatch #2216 final PR head.
intent.objective: Verify a developer can lock all four dependency sources, distinguish unchanged/stale inputs, and restore executable consumer imports, with prospective measured evidence.

criteria.text: Generate pylock.combo.toml; parse lock-version 1.0; exactly four pinned package versions from project, environment, extra and dependency group; SHA-256 hashes on every available wheel/sdist entry. Bounded structure, not PEP 751 certification.
Unchanged dependency inputs: hatch env lock combo --check exits 0. An unrelated resolver error must remain failure.

Change available six input from 1.17.0 to 1.16.0: --check exits exactly 1 and reports Lockfile is not up to date; restore exact original inputs. Exit 2 is an execution error, not proof of semantic stale detection.
Remove all four consumer packages, observe import failure, run hatch dep sync and import all four exact pinned versions successfully in the same consumer environment.

Existing focused lock-command tests report 28 passing tests, with 7 network tests deselected; report mocked tests separately from consumer workflow evidence. Parent snapshot has no new lock test files, which is availability rather than a quality regression.
